reconstructed_theorem_text: Let (Ω,Σ) be a measurable space with a finite measure μ and let S be a compact, pseudometrizable, second-countable topological space equipped with its Borel σ-algebra. Put ℝ₊=[0,∞), with its usual topology and Borel structure, and let (ℱ_a)_{a∈ℝ₊} be a filtration on Ω. Let X:ℝ₊×Ω→S be jointly measurable and strongly progressive for this filtration. Let c:ℝ₊×S→ℝ be continuous for the product topology, and define b(t,ω)=c(t,X(t,ω)). For every T∈ℝ₊ and every p∈[0,∞], all three statements hold. First, b is strongly progressive on all of ℝ₊, meaning that for every a∈ℝ₊ the map (t,ω)↦b(t,ω) on [0,a]×Ω is strongly measurable for the product of the time Borel σ-algebra restricted to [0,a] and ℱ_a. Second, for every ω∈Ω, the real time section t↦b(t,ω) is integrable against λ_T, the pullback by NNReal.toReal of real Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T]. Third, the map (ω,t)↦b(t,ω) on Ω×ℝ₊ belongs to MemLp with exponent p for the sample-first product measure μ⊗λ_T.
objects: A measurable sample space (Ω,Σ), finite measure μ, compact pseudometrizable second-countable Borel state space S, nonnegative-time filtration ℱ, state process X, continuous real coefficient c, real process b(t,ω)=c(t,X(t,ω)), horizon T, and exponent p.
domains: X is time-first on ℝ₊×Ω, c is on ℝ₊×S, and b is real-valued on ℝ₊×Ω. For each cutoff a, strong progressivity uses the measurable subtype [0,a] of ℝ₊ times Ω with source σ-algebra Borel([0,a])⊗ℱ_a. For the section assertion the measure is λ_T=Measure.comap NNReal.toReal (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 (↑T))) on ℝ₊. For MemLp the source is Ω×ℝ₊, the map is processFunction b(ω,t)=b(t,ω), and the product measure is μ.prod λ_T, using the ambient sample σ-algebra Σ.
quantifiers: Universally quantify Ω, S, all displayed structures, ℱ, μ, X, and c subject to the hypotheses, and then T∈ℝ₊ and p∈ℝ≥0∞. The strong-progressivity condition quantifies over every time cutoff a∈ℝ₊. The section-integrability conclusion quantifies over every individual sample ω∈Ω.
assumptions: S is compact, pseudometrizable, second-countable, and equipped with its Borel σ-algebra. μ is finite. The uncurried X is measurable for the full ambient product measurable structure and X is strongly progressive for ℱ. The coefficient c is jointly continuous. There is no strict positivity assumption on T and no restriction on the exponent p beyond its type ℝ≥0∞.
conclusion: For b(t,ω)=c(t,X(t,ω)), the conjunction is IsStronglyProgressive ℱ b, Integrable(t↦b(t,ω),λ_T) for every ω∈Ω, and MemLp((ω,t)↦b(t,ω),p,μ⊗λ_T).
scopes: Progressivity of b is global and its cutoff a is independent of the integration horizon T. Integrability of each time section is pointwise in ω, with no exceptional set. The MemLp conclusion uses the sample-first product measure, with the time factor supported on [0,T]. It holds for every extended nonnegative exponent, including p=0 and p=∞, and T=0 is allowed. Joint measurability and progressivity are distinct hypotheses on X. No sample-path continuity is assumed.
constant_dependencies: The proposition specifies no numerical bound or norm constant. λ_T and the product-space integrability domain depend on T. The MemLp exponent is p, while the strong-progressivity and section-integrability assertions do not depend on p.
